meta.title: Nabd: every device has a pulse
meta.description: Real-time IoT monitoring with real hardware: ESP32 nodes, MQTT over TLS, live dashboards, WhatsApp alerts, remote relay control and signed firmware updates.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.body: 12 simulated nodes and 1 real board. Relays here are safe to flip.

apiDown.title: Can't reach the Nabd API
apiDown.body: The dashboard needs the API, the broker and the database. Start them with pnpm infra:up and pnpm dev, then reload.

device.timeoutNote: Command {id} times out after 10 s with no reply, and the switch returns to its real state.
device.timedOut: No reply within 10 s. The switch shows the device's real state again.
device.forbidden: Only the owner can switch the real board. Try a simulated device such as nabd-05.
device.rateLimited: One command every 3 seconds in the demo. Try again in a moment.
device.otaReady: Version {v} is signed and ready. The node keeps {current} as a fallback and rolls back if it doesn't check in within 2 minutes.
device.otaNone: No signed release newer than {current} yet.
device.otaSent: Offer sent. The node downloads, verifies and reboots into {v}.
device.rawEmpty: Messages appear here as the device publishes them.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.none: No alerts. Rules that fire show up here.
alerts.escalate: Escalate to owner after 15 min unacknowledged
alerts.backtest: Tested against the last 7 days: would have fired {n} times.
alerts.adminOnly: Saving and test messages need the owner's login. You can still try the backtest.
alerts.previewNote: Sent with an approved WhatsApp Cloud API template. Replies come back by webhook.
alerts.ackReply: Acknowledged by you. Nabd will message again when it clears.

firmware.title: Firmware
firmware.subtitle: Signed releases (ECDSA P-256). Devices verify the signature before they install.
firmware.none: No releases yet. Build, then sign with scripts/sign-firmware.ts.
